introduction: BrowserWindow creates a desktop window. Wait for app readiness before creating it, then load a local page. Your task: Change the window width to 900.

blocks.text: BrowserWindow creates a desktop window. Wait for app readiness before creating it, then load a local page.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.
Read the code step by step

items: `contextIsolation: true` separates preload context from page script context. Keep `nodeIntegration` off for the renderer.

blocks.text: A local index.html file opens in an 800 by 600 window.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create the HTML file first. Keep Node integration off for renderer pages.
